text:
Zoe: Hey everyone — two quick personal updates! 1) Nate and I just closed on a tiny house (first-time homeowners!!! 🏡). 2) I'm also expecting a baby due in Oct 🎉👶. Oh — and I accepted a promotion to Staff SWE starting next month. Wanted to share the good news with the whole crew :)
Asha: Aaaahhh congrats Zoe!!! all the emotions 🥹🥳 housewarming + baby shower combo maybe?
Raj: Huge congratulations on both the promotion and the baby and the house — triple win :rocket: so happy for you two
Lina: This is amazing!! If you're up for it, I can coordinate a potluck/mini shower. Weeknight or weekend better? I'm thinking casual snacks + a tiny non-alcoholic mocktail bar. :tada:
Zoe: Thanks y'all!! We're leaning toward late June for moving day, and would LOVE a potluck after we're settled. Weekends work best for us. Also no pressure on a shower — just vibes and snacks are perfect.
Max: Count me in for grilling duty or bringing nachos. Also happy to help move boxes if you need an extra pair of hands 💪
Nate: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the love. Moving date still tentative, will confirm once the movers call back.
hr-bot: Congrats Zoe on your promotion! Please check the promotion checklist in #people-ops and reach out to People Ops for title/comp updates.
Asha: Poll idea — 1) weekend potluck after move, 2) small office celebration before you leave for parental leave, 3) both? react with :one:, :two:, or :three: to vote
Raj: :one: for me (weekend potluck)
Lina: :three: both please haha
Max: :one: or :three: depends on which weekend, but leaning :one:
Zoe: Love this. I'll post a Doodle/Tally with possible dates next week and DM people for moving help. Thank you all so much — feeling very lucky right now ❤️
